poem.name: A Poem
poem.description:
A golden wound upon the endless blue,
				Bleeding its warmth for those it never knew.
				A thousand distant eyes adorn the night,
				Yet none shall lead the faithless toward the light.
				A borrowed face that fades before the day,
				A silent witness slowly swept away.
				An empty circle once bestowed on kings,
				Now rests forgotten, stripped of all its things.
				A fragile bloom where paradise has died,
				Still reaching for the heavens from below.
				Two paths entwined beneath the sacred sky,
				Where faith ascends, yet all its prayers must die.
